lines.text: Right, so what we're gonna do is, er, I'm gonna put you into groups, but before that there are a few things we've gotta sort out. So just jot down, if you've got a pencil, could you write this, then when we've finished that we're going to move on to the next bit, which involves…
lines.how: Say it as a nervous, rambling teacher: hesitant, with filler, a little too fast, trailing off at the end.
Say it as a calm, clear teacher giving one short instruction, at a steady pace, with a pause after it.

lines.text: Read the five questions. Don't write.
